D/ CONSTANTINVS IVN NOB C ; R/ GLORI A EXERC ITVS

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Constantine II (317-340), Trier mint Gloria Exercitus issue of 330-335, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Youthful bust cuirassed and ?diademed right. Obverse inscription: CONSTANTINVS IVN NOB C. Reverse description: Two soldiers with two standards between them. Reverse inscription: GLORI A EXERC ITVS. In exergue: possibly PT[R]. Diameter: 15.9mm, Weight: 1.97gms, die axis: 12
